title: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with Merrimac Paper Company.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department further Approves the Company's request to retain the revenue from the contract. The Department also finds that eht pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-23)
